Tokopedia Era B (product_families[] gated to US local sellers)

framing: Inference for the nine: every one either has no container content to place at an intermediate level (Google, Walmart, Amazon's flat rows) or places all shared content at one level already. A second level buys nothing unless there is content that belongs neither to the whole family nor to one member — exactly the case Akeneo names and nobody else has.

rows.shape: “Child products are unique, sellable products that are related in our catalog to a single, non-sellable parent product”; “You must remove a child listing from its current parent-child relationship before you relate it to a new parent”; feed error 8032.
Product → ProductVariant, one level; “There is no ‘no variant’ state.” (a standalone product carries the synthesized Title / Default Title option and variant).
item_group_id is one string on the row; there is no second grouping level.
InventoryItemGroup --1..N--> InventoryItem by SKU string; one level.
“An item can belong to only one variant group.” One level (variantGroupId string on each member).
catalog_product_super_link has both FKs on catalog_product_entity.entity_id with UNIQUE (product_id, parent_id) — one level, but a child may hang off several parents.
The child is a product_variation post whose post_parent is the container; a non-product parent is reset to 0.
One level in both models: Classic embeds ProductVariants inside ProductData; Modular gives Variant a single product reference upward — Variant --1..1--> Product.

rows.h: exactly two; the cap is a compiled constant; reason = content placement per colour
rows.shape: private const MAXIMUM_LEVEL_NUMBER = 2; (FamilyVariantValidator.php:20, enforced :154-197). Spec: “Number representing the level of the attribute set. It should be equal to 1 or 2. If you specify the level 2, you have to specify the level 1 as well.” ProductModel.parent is a self-reference (parent_id, CASCADE). Stated why: “The attributes that vary by color (variant level 1) are the composition and the pictures. Finally, the attributes that differ by color and size (variant level 2) are the EAN, the SKU, and the weight.” Levels are attribute-disjoint: “Attributes used as axes in one level cannot be used as axes or as attributes in the other level.”

rows.h: feature-gated (Beta); reason = an addressable subset; cost = disables slicing
rows.shape: “A variation group is a subset of variations that are part of a base product.”; “you assign multiple variation groups to that base product”; “A variation group can include only one value of a variation attribute.” Gated: “Reserved for Beta users. Variation groups will not be created and a warning will be logged if the Variation Groups (Beta) feature is disabled.” Cost: “disables slicing … when variation groups exist for a base product, but only for that product.”
